children: Cummins India Limited, a leading power solutions technology provider, announced the appointment of Gbile Adewunmi as Managing Director of Cummins India Limited and India Regional Leader, effective November 01, 2026.  He will assume these responsibilities in addition to his current role as leader of Industrial Markets within Power Systems and will continue leading the Industrial Markets line of business.

“Gbile is a respected global leader with deep experience across Cummins and a strong track record of delivering customer-focused growth and business performance," said Jenny Bush, President of Power Systems. "His enterprise perspective, ability to build high-performing teams and commitment to our customers make him exceptionally well positioned to lead Cummins India Limited and the India region while continuing to advance our Industrial Markets strategy.”

Gbile currently serves as Vice President, Power Systems Industrial Markets at Cummins. In this role, he has led work with customers and partners across demanding industrial markets, including mining, to deliver practical and scalable power solutions. In this role, he has worked with customers and partners across industrial markets, including mining, to advance hybrid-electric retrofit solutions, mining technologies and other power solutions that support customer productivity, reliability and emissions-reduction goals.

India remains a strategic growth market for Cummins and an important part of the company’s future. With a strong leadership team, talented employees and a clear strategy, Cummins India Limited is well positioned to continue building on its momentum and delivering for customers across the region.

“I am honored to take on this expanded role and to work alongside the talented teams across Cummins India Limited, the India region and Industrial Markets,” said Adewunmi. “India is a critical market for Cummins, and I look forward to partnering with our employees, customers and stakeholders to build on our strong foundation and continue powering a more prosperous world.”
